attempts.summary: Held curl at its current version (curl-7.29.0-59.el7.x86_64) on node1 by adding `exclude=curl` to /etc/yum.conf [main], the native RHEL7/yum mechanism to prevent a package from being touched by `yum update`. yum-plugin-versionlock could not be installed because node1 has no enabled repos (offline), so the built-in exclude directive was used instead. Verified the setting is syntactically valid (yum parses config without error) and that curl's installed version is unaffected. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline, restarted node1 via sudo reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and re-verified post-restart that curl's version and the yum.conf exclude=curl hold both persisted, with the node reporting systemctl is-system-running = running.
